assembly_notes: The object is ONE basket: a single tub part carries every wall/rim/grip visual; carry bails, lids, front panels and interior fittings are parallel children of that tub, never chained through each other. handle and closure are deliberately ONE slot (top_configuration): a bail arching over the mouth and a lid seating on it occupy the same space, so per AUTHORING they are one structural family rather than two slots behind a compatibility gate. Closed-top candidates carry the molded short-wall grip cutouts the hinged-lid source uses in place of a bail. The tub wall and floor stay closed: side-opening gates and under-basket drawers were rejected in review, so no opening is cut through the shell. Every rotational joint is solved with mate_axes and registered with register_interface_mate, and no assembly uses allow_overlap: captured pivots are expressed as a bore with a running clearance around a real axle, not as interpenetrating solids.

derived.expression: closed mouth outline of the selected body form (rectangle with corner fillets, ellipse, hexagon, or circle) offset outward by rim_lip_m
derived.name: rim_profile
derived.rationale: One profile drives the rim, the lid outline and the hinge line, so they cannot disagree.

derived.expression: rim_profile inset by a running clearance; a hexagonal mouth yields a hexagonal lid and a round mouth a round lid
derived.name: lid_outline
derived.rationale: A lid whose outline ignores the host profile overhangs the corners of every non-rectangular mouth.

derived.expression: point on the rim_profile edge nearest +Y at rim height, with the axle laid along the local edge tangent
derived.name: hinge_axle_origin
derived.rationale: The hinge sits on the real rim edge of whichever profile is selected.

derived.expression: rim height less the rim lip and one bail bar radius, so the boss bore sits in solid wall
derived.name: pivot_axle_z
derived.rationale: Bail pivots must sit on real hardware, not float at the rim line.

derived.expression: upper short-wall band centred one grip height below the rim
derived.name: grip_band_z
derived.rationale: Molded grips replace the bail on the closed-top configurations.

derived.expression: mouth profile scaled by taper_ratio and inset by wall_thickness_m
derived.name: cavity_floor_profile
derived.rationale: Interior fittings size against the real floor polygon of the selected form.

derived.expression: rib inner faces set one running clearance outside the tray walls, held vertical while the tub wall tapers away
derived.name: caddy_guide_span
derived.rationale: Constant side clearance is what keeps the tray supported over the whole lift.

derived.expression: rib top height less the tray seat and the minimum retained rib engagement
derived.name: caddy_lift_m
derived.rationale: The stroke is bounded by the retention hardware rather than being free travel.
